title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go + v1.34.0 parity bump
author: Priya Patel
description:
Motivation: bring Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to parity for auth configuration (token sources + KMS hooks), standardized retry strategies, and a consistent streaming API ergonomics. This PR consolidates the surface area so cross-language examples and server-side integrations behave identically and so we can cut the v1.34.0 parity release. Summary of changes: 1) Auth: introduce unified AuthProvider interface across SDKs, add support for credential chaining (env -> kube secret -> external KMS), and add optional token refresh hooks for long-running streams. 2) Retries: standardized retry policy config (maxAttempts/backoff strategy/shouldRetry hook) and default mapping from Redwood runtime error codes to retryable categories. 3) Streaming ergonomics: unify stream iterator vs callback behavior; add cancelable context support in Go, async iterator helpers in Python, and a consistent browser/node streaming API in TS. 4) Parity & version bumps: align examples, integration tests, and bump package versions to v1.34.0 across SDKs. Backwards compatibility: defaults are preserved (old constructors still work but emit a deprecation warning and delegate to the new builder-style APIs). Migration notes are included below. Testing: unit tests for auth chaining and token refresh (python/ts/go), integration tests against the local mock server for retry and streaming scenarios, e2e smoke tests in the CI matrix. Rollout: merge to main, publish staged packages behind the SDK release pipeline, coordinate release notes and migration guide. Checklist: - [x] Design doc approved (ENG-5421) - [x] Cross-language integration tests - [x] Docs and examples updated - [x] Migration guide in docs repo - [x] QA smoke passed on linux/mac/windows - [x] CI green (flake fixes applied)

Compatibility & migration notes: - Python: prefer ClientBuilder().with_auth_provider(...) over legacy auth param; legacy Client(auth=...) still supported for one release. - TypeScript: Streaming now returns AsyncIterable<Message> from client.stream() by default; callback-based stream() remains available as client.stream({mode: 'callback'}) for one release. - Go: streams accept context.Context for cancellation; updated examples show graceful shutdown patterns. - Retry defaults tightened to avoid excessive token refresh storms; advanced users can pass a RetryPolicy object. Related: SDK RFC (ENG-5421), internal sprint ticket SDK-921.
